def execute_faceless_void_chronosphere_dota(ctx, actor, target, cfg):
    # LORE INTENT: Encloses nearby units in a sphere that freezes their time while Void moves freely inside.
    if not ctx.owns_ability(actor, ability_id): return NOT_OWNED
    if not ctx.check_explicit_conditions(actor, target, cfg): return DENIED
    tx = ctx.begin_effect(ability_id, actor, target)
    if target_resists(status_kind, ability): return RESISTED
    effect = add_or_refresh_status_instance(target,status_kind,stacks,duration)
    on_tick: apply_status_specific_periodic_effect_if_any(effect)
    on_update: recompute_movement_ai_or_cast_permissions(target)
    on_expiry_or_cleanse: remove_instance_and_recalculate(target)
    tx.commit_if_valid()
    ctx.emit_effect_event(ability_id)
    return SUCCESS
